name: 折纸雾紫清透面部防晒霜款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: hand-pleated mist-lilac paper sweep #E7E3EE with standing vertical knife folds, interchangeable with one deep ink-violet paper field #2F2A45 and paper-white card faces #FAF9FD; horizon-free, no outdoor scenery, no water
styleLock.lightingSystem: one large scrim-softened top-front softbox as the single key, one cool bounce card on the shadow side, narrow crisp shadows falling only along the paper folds, low-contrast modeling, at most one thin specular line per surface, no hard-edged shadow bands
styleLock.surfaceSystem: chamfered folded-paper plinth blocks and risers in greyed lilac #CFC9DE with knife-edge creases and a dry matte paper nap; the product always sits on a paper edge with a visible soft contact shadow
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; headline plus two short label rails maximum, all copy carried as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in ink violet #2F2A45 inside blank rounded square chips, no filled badges, no medals, no seal artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: product scale held within one band per role band 40-70 percent, upright or leaning against a paper riser, label face always readable, never floating without a contact shadow, never duplicated inside one frame
noDrift: no color palette changes outside mist-lilac #E7E3EE, folded plinth #CFC9DE, ink violet #2F2A45 and iris lilac #B4A0E4
no pleated-paper background replaced by stone, sand, shell, glass, plaster, cloud, down or any outdoor surface
no hard-edged louver shadow band, no low sun streak, no backlit gel flag glow
no mixed fonts, no handwritten or script lettering
no invented certificate frames, seals, ratings or review copy
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent sculpted paper-studio skincare system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pleated mist-lilac paper field #E7E3EE, greyed-lilac folded plinth #CFC9DE, deep ink-violet paper field #2F2A45, paper-white card face #FAF9FD and a single iris-lilac accent #B4A0E4; cool temperature throughout; lighting from one large scrim-softened top-front softbox with one cool bounce card, narrow crisp shadows confined to the paper folds, low contrast, at most one thin specular line and never a hard-edged shadow band; every background is hand-pleated paper or ink-violet paper, horizon-free, never stone, sand, shell, glass, plaster, cloud, water or outdoor scenery; the product always rests on a chamfered folded-paper riser with a visible soft contact shadow; one modern geometric sans-serif family, headline plus at most two short label rails, all copy left as placeholders; thin single-weight line glyphs inside blank rounded square chips only; stable product scale and angle per role; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented credentials.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：第1屏双支软管斜立于紫色渐变台与一道竖棱圆盘前，顶部主张句加一枚胶囊副句；第2屏四枚细线图标条压在紫水面纹上，下接 PRODUCT PARAMETERS 商品参数双列表格（含品牌、品名、规格 150ML/瓶、功效、适合人群、保质 5 年、盒装、注意事项八行）；第3屏「是否被防晒BUG所困扰」2x2 四格女模特写，四态分别为搓泥、油腻、晒黑、脱妆；第4屏单支浮于一枚透光紫色圆盘前，左上 UVA/UVB 锯齿箭头符号，中列三上三下箭头，下方两句强弱对照；第5屏三片重叠乳白圆碟装绿叶、向日葵与蓝色分子链示意，旁注三个成分名与功效句；第6屏墨紫漩涡场中双支，左侧 1/2/3 三重利益编号栏带弧线引线；第7屏「口碑赞誉」两幅手背点膏实拍配两段买家评价文字；第8屏 STEP 01-03 线描上脸教程三格，下方「产品展示」单支正身，左下角另有加入会员字样与二维码。品类判定依据：第2屏参数区品名为防晒霜、适合人群为成人，第8屏步骤文案写明洁面后涂于面部或身体所需部位且属驻留型膏体，既非冲洗类，亦非着色彩妆，故归 护肤个护/面部护理，产品族 beauty；源夹名写作「洗护-防晒霜」，其中「洗护」与图内证据不符，已按图改判，未落入洗护发。已剥离内容：原品牌中英文字标与品名字样、管身英文字标、全部原文案原句（含主张句、四痛点的原字、三重利益原句、成分名与功效断言、两段买家评价）、参数表内 150ML 与 5 年等数值、UVA/UVB 字母、加入会员与全店免费角标、二维码、四位模特面容与身份以及第5屏可辨识植物与分子结构。所有数值与资质位一律改为空白参数行、空引述条、空标签轨与 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位，屏幕与刻度不写读数。与既有近似套图的差异逐条：一，背景材质改为手打褶皱雾李纸场与折纸斜切台座，不用石台棉布、细沙纹贝壳、磨砂蚀刻玻璃层板、拉丝钢栏、雾蓝云团、羽绒、冷瓷滤光旗与暖陶釉面板；二，色板改用雾李折纸场 #E7E3EE、折纸台板 #CFC9DE、墨紫深场 #2F2A45、虹李强调 #B4A0E4 与纸白卡面 #FAF9FD，与七套既有防晒色板无一重合，且不含橙金珊瑚与柑黄；三，光位改为大柔光箱覆硫酸纸纱幕的单盏顶前柔光，阴影只沿折纸棱线生成窄而清晰的结构影，不设硬边帘影投影带、不设低角度掠射硬日光、不设背透滤光旗光；四，机位体系为 front、three-quarter、side、overhead、high 五桶轮换，含一镜正上方平摊与一镜 high 45 参数页，十镜无一三连同机位；五，角色序列为 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>DETAIL>COMPARISON>DETAIL>DETAIL>SCENE>TRUST>CTA 共十镜，区别于七套的七至九镜排法；六，版式元件换成折纸斜切台、空白标本圆碟、八行空白参数卡与空白动作板。temperature 取 cool 与同夹多套相同，该字段已被多套占满，故按批次契约改以色板构成、纸材台座、光位、机位与版式元件完成区分。
